variants.name: 01-navy-captain
variants.prompt:
Use case: product ui-mockup / shareable payment card. Create ONE premium standalone portrait 3:4 Socially Solana wallet QR image for sharing on messaging apps. No physical phone, no status bar, no UI controls, no multi-panel collage.
Reference roles: Image 1 is a bank QR share card, use COMPOSITION ONLY: top centered brand, oversized rounded white rectangular QR panel, circular owner badge overlapping the top panel edge, recipient identity, large dense square QR, supporting footer outside card. Do not reproduce the bank logo, red palette, UPI number, bank names or payment app logos. Image 2 is the actual Socially captain logo: REDESIGN it into a refined brand-faithful emblem appropriate to this card. Preserve recognizable captain face silhouette, tricorn hat, beard, eyepatch and seafaring identity; simplify as crisp flat engraved navy/ice-blue mark, no candlestick graphics, no generic boat, no shiny 3D app tile. Place redesigned emblem in a small circular navy/white seal at the EXACT CENTER of QR; white isolation ring around seal. Center emblem diameter about 13% of QR width. Also use a smaller matching emblem beside SOCIALLY wordmark at top. DO NOT put a giant logo across QR.
Brand palette: Socially navy #173652 and #102C46, pale icy blue #E5EDF7, snowy white, restrained mint accent allowed. Elegant Cormorant Garamond-like editorial serif and clear Inter sans. Main white card has generous rounded corners, ample spacing, no busy decoration near code. Circular owner badge overlapping the card top edge shows letter 'V'. Recipient text 'Vikas' beneath badge, small descriptor 'Solana wallet'. Then DENSE realistic-looking QR grid about 37x37 or 41x41 modules: many SMALL crisp square modules, detailed varied encoded-looking pattern with three standard sharp square finder patterns; realistic intricacy similar to reference bank QR, NOT earlier chunky oversimplified 21x21 art; no dots, no colored QR gradient. QR navy on pure white, ample quiet zone. QR is illustrative concept only; do not reuse the original bank QR.
Below QR inside card label 'Wallet Address:' followed by FULL sample address '2xv2aWMUEesXsbTwFwQcxNrJn4HebPVBCrYihQ8K3Zvg' on ONE SINGLE LINE, no ellipsis, no wrapping or clipping. Use appropriately small readable monospaced font and wide footer. Outside card, exact footer 'This address is for Solana assets only.' in readable contrasting text, with small Solana emblem. Optional short instruction 'Scan to send to my wallet' inside card above QR or as subtle caption. Do not add extra slogans, security claims, bank logos, fake wallet app logos or copy/share buttons. Make polished intentional visual hierarchy and dense useful QR focus. Avoid tall empty bottom waste. Classic navy payment card. Navy outer backdrop with very faint ocean contour lines only at corners. Small ice-white captain emblem and SOCIALLY centered at top. White rounded panel with a navy V badge overlapping top center, Vikas in navy serif below. Dense navy QR with centered flat white captain profile on navy round seal. Full address single line inside card footer. Exact Solana-only note outside card in pale blue. Closest composition to banking inspiration with Socially identity.
